A dystopian authoritarian society, with AI thought police is at least 50 percent as likely as anything else, it seems everyday we move more closely to a future like that.  And then maybe 30 percent odds, we mostly keep the system we have, just AI makes rich people much much richer and poor people much much more poor, since the profits will be concentrated to the companies with AI products. 

The least likely outcome to me, is this benevolent future, where somehow consumers have money to spend on goods and services. The vast majority of consumers are labor of some kind. Most CEOs take a pay check and use that money to fund their lifestyle. The distribution of resources has been concentrating for many years. And AI allows for greater concentration. It's difficult to see how AI would suddenly make investors or business leaders to act against their best interest, to share more with society or employees.

So sure, if you only count wealthy people and corporations as people, then sure, everyone will be able to have what they want.
